description.value: Yummy Slice Pizza is a Canadian-owned pizza chain offering takeout and delivery, with locations across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. The McCallum Road location is one of several Lower Mainland branches of the growing franchise, known for pizza by the slice and a broad menu of classic and signature pies. Touring cyclists passing through Abbotsford will find a quick, filling stop with a wide range of topping combinations.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record tags this as a fast-food pizza takeout/delivery business; the website confirms it is the Abbotsford branch of the Yummy Slice Pizza chain (contact page explicitly lists 'ABBOTSFORD 2388 McCallum Rd'), contradicting the OSM community field of 'Chilliwack' — the postal code V2S 3P4 also resolves to Abbotsford. Takeout is confirmed by both OSM ('takeaway': 'yes') and the website ('PIZZA TAKEOUT & DELIVERY RESTAURANT'); the menu page shows multiple vegetarian-suitable pizzas (Veggie Lovers, Greek, Garden Pesto, Yummy Veggie, Yummy Paneer, Tandoori Paneer, etc.). No bike-specific amenities — parking, water refill, or washrooms — are mentioned anywhere in the OSM tags or website content.
concerns: OSM community field is 'Chilliwack' but the website contact page explicitly lists 2388 McCallum Rd under 'ABBOTSFORD', and the postal code V2S 3P4 is an Abbotsford code. The OSM community tag should be corrected to Abbotsford.
Per-location phone number not listed on the website; OSM phone (+1-604-744-4407) could not be confirmed against website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, actively operating takeout pizza business convenient for cyclists needing a quick calorie stop in Abbotsford; vegetarian options confirmed. Bike-specific amenities are unverified but the food-stop value is clear.
